sourceEvidence.label: LogiCommerce threat model and production-readiness requirements

assessment.summary: Source evidence supports a central, tenant-scoped operational evidence boundary.

assumptions: No production load, penetration, or restore measurement was supplied.

opportunities.title: Govern high-impact transitions and operational evidence
opportunities.summary: Centralize permissioned operational evidence without merging domain ownership.
opportunities.diagnosis: The threat model requires immutable audits and dual approval while readiness evidence previously existed only as planned documentation.

evidence.claim: Cross-tenant access, refund and payout abuse, secret leakage, and privileged insider actions are named high-risk threats.
High-impact workflows benefit from shared evidence semantics while retaining domain-owned state transitions.

desiredInvariants: Every high-impact action is tenant-scoped, permissioned, attributable, and state constrained.
Posted ledgers and decision history are compensated rather than overwritten.
Operational claims have recorded observations or exercises.

options.title: Keep local runbooks and focused guards
options.summary: Document controls and keep evidence outside the application.

evidenceCoverage.rationale: Runbooks guide response but cannot enforce attribution or tenant isolation.

tradeoffs.assessment: Focused ingress guards narrow common abuse but evidence can drift.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Review incident and restore artifacts quarterly.

tradeoffs.assessment: No application write path is added.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Compare request latency before and after ingress limits.

tradeoffs.assessment: No new runtime store is introduced.
Runbooks improve consistency only when followed.
Procedures become discoverable but evidence remains fragmented.

residualRisks: Evidence may be mutable, incomplete, or assigned to the wrong tenant.

acceptanceCriteria: Operators can execute a tabletop exercise.

options.title: Add a central tenant-scoped evidence boundary
options.summary: Record SLO, recovery, retention, privacy, approval, and rollback evidence through guarded APIs.

evidenceCoverage.rationale: Central evidence complements, but does not replace, ingress limits and domain-specific validation.

tradeoffs.assessment: Permission, tenant, approval, and immutable-history controls become enforceable.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Run cross-tenant and unauthorized transition tests.

tradeoffs.assessment: Evidence writes add database work only to control-plane actions.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Load control-plane endpoints against p95 150 ms.

tradeoffs.assessment: Bounded route metrics retain one aggregate per route.
State-constrained exercises and rollback evidence reduce ambiguous recovery.
Evidence is queryable but production still needs durable telemetry export.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Integrate and alert from selected telemetry backend.

tradeoffs.assessment: Additive tables, permissions, and operator workflows are required.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Exercise forward migration and application rollback.

residualRisks: In-process metrics are not cross-replica durable.
A privileged operator can still submit false evidence without external attestation.

acceptanceCriteria: Recovery records calculate pass/fail against RPO/RTO.
High-impact decisions retain actor and reason.
migrationNotes: Deploy additive schema before application readers.
implementationReadiness.rollback: Roll back application while retaining additive evidence tables.

opportunities.recommendation: Use the central evidence boundary under the current modular-monolith constraints.

openQuestions: Which durable telemetry, backup, secret-management, and production orchestration providers will be selected?
